approval.decision: Kris reviewed every item of the a-v1 and b-v1 drafts in the lab, asked for changes that went into a-v2, and approved the combined revision on screen with "Yes do it". Approve a-v2, named "Story release fixes combined", with the recorded source, captures and behaviour. Item decisions: diagnostics A with changes ("Within the choice area I prefer the error highlighting of B with its red, can we apply that to A?"; "2 is the best I think update the Av2"; "Yes to both"); set-variable approved ("Yes to both"); protected A; move-protected B; delete-scene A with changes ("I like A but it looks a little sloppy"; "Can we make the hierarchy after Chapter 1 more clear?"; "Yes approved"); transition B with reworded help ("Can you refine the text in b more it's unclear"; "Yes"); transition-add approved with the mock's line ("use the mocks line"); moved-draft A; screen-beat approved; screen-beat-changed approved with spacing refined ("Yes good"); tracks-summary approved.
